name: higher_lower
description: Fallback game (pre-written and tested; on stage Claude writes its own). Higher or lower, numbers 1-10. The robot shows a number; thumbs up = the next one is higher, thumbs down = lower. Right: +1 and the game goes on. Wrong: the game ends.

start.description: Reset the score, draw the first number, explain.

on_enter.speak: Higher or lower. Thumbs up if the next number is higher, thumbs down if it is lower.

guess.description: Show the number, draw the hidden next one (never equal), wait for the player's thumb.

on_enter.speak: The number is {number}. Higher or lower?

do.speak: Too slow. Thumbs up or thumbs down?

game_over.description: A wrong guess ends the game. Start again with start_machine.
